name: 2061-longdecode-dsv2fp8-tp8
model: neuralmagic/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8 -- ungated, but the id redirects to RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8 and is kept in this spelling. ~237 GB, and it downloads once before the first run.
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8 with data-parallel attention: the MoE half is one tensor-parallel group over the eight cards, the attention half is eight independent workers each holding the full KV of its own requests. Data parallel size follows tensor parallel size. No pipeline parallelism.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 236B parameters in FP8: 60 layers, MLA (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64), MoE with 160 routed experts + 2 shared, top-6. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, which is 32 per attention worker, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 2000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 512 prompt tokens and 2048 generated tokens, both fixed (stdev 0). `ignore_eos` and `temperature: 0` are set through `backend.extras.body`, so every request generates exactly 2048 tokens. Seed 42.
purpose: A 236-billion-parameter coding assistant writing long code files for 256 concurrent developers on eight GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped by the engine's line reader and the
# key then never reaches the engine.

model-path: neuralmagic/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true
disable-radix-cache: true

# Exactly what the engine derives for itself at tp-size >= 8; written down so it cannot drift.
mem-fraction-static: 0.82

# The longest request this workload draws is 512 + 2048 = 2560, so nothing is truncated. The
# checkpoint advertises 163840 positions, which would size a ~1.3 GB per-card request table.
context-length: 4096

random-seed: 42
